verdict.rationale: Batch-job pricing is a fair question for an LLM model family that could offer a first-party hosted API. However, the evidence covers only weight downloads, local runtimes and partner hosting, with no documented asynchronous batch API or batch discount. Partner-hosted offerings are host-platform capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can submit asynchronous batch jobs at a documented discount versus real-time pricing
